cc:Work.dc:title: Selection over the complete parameter grid
cc:Work.dc:description: Every predeclared candidate is shown: 2 K values × 2 home advantages × 3 draw/scale values per family. Cells are frozen-model 2022–23 validation log loss; lower is better. Orange outlines mark the selected candidate.
